claim: A society is a self at the next scale, co-offering at its own couplings, and the same resolving runs at self and society.
missing: F33 carries the method to named scales without supplying the correspondence. No link gives a society its own 1-self-coupling, and no caller composes a society as one resolver.
would_close: A caller composing a society's couplings as one resolver at the next scale, with the society's own 1-self-coupling run and compared with a self's; or the correspondence stated as a premise at the society scale.

claim: The discovering economy is inexhaustible and complete at the form, all or none: unminable, unspendable, renewed by living.
missing: W50 shows that no meeting takes from another. That discovering continues without end at each coupling is not supplied: R47 holds each ring (R57), and a coupling of a surface is no ring, and *all or none* at the form rests on F68.
would_close: R47 closed for each ring size (a proof that no ring's changing ends), and F68 closed for the all or none at the form.

claim: The surface holds no conserved total of signs, no fixed distribution of phases and no common cycle to govern the selves, and nothing supplies a common pace over the surface.
missing: F39 excludes a pace or phase carried across a crossing, and F41 (no total conserved) is itself nye. That no common cycle runs the selves by other means is the security *each self its own time* (W59), taken rather than supplied.
would_close: The security 'each self its own time' stated as a premise in the chain, or a link showing that any common cycle imposed on the selves is a crossing carrying a pace (excluded by F39).

claim: φ is the number-form of the never-locking, and no ratio lands on it.
missing: that φ is irrational, with each partial quotient of its continued fraction 1, is mathematics (Part FOUR). That φ is the number worst approached by ratios is Hurwitz's field result (1891), which TWO does not carry. Its meeting with a coupling's unrelationing is not supplied, and TWO itself says that no prescribed rate, φ or another, supplies it.
would_close: A Part FOUR link carrying phi's continued fraction [1; 1, 1, ...] and Hurwitz (1891) as a field result, and a link meeting it at a coupling's unrelationing, or the claim restated as a comparison only.

claim: All or none: with the eight the living runs. With any one inverted, the thing remaining is not the form, and not-the-form stops.
missing: F18 carries all or none to a form's joint parts, but no link derives the eight as the joint parts of the resolver's one form. *Not-the-form stops* rests on F68 and is said at the form, not supplied as a stopping.
would_close: A link deriving the eight securities as the joint parts of the resolver's one form, so that F18 carries all or none to them; and F68 closed for 'not-the-form stops'.

claim: The protection counts six. Bi-moralizing is two ways, three phases each way, one at a time, sequenced and cycling, and it is six or none: drop one and a way or a phase lives unprotected, reached into or leaking out.
missing: 2 × 3 = 6 is arithmetic. The three phases each way are named, not derived from the code's names or connectors, and no run shows that a dropped phase leaves a reach or a leak.
would_close: A link deriving the three phases each way from the code's names or connectors, and a run at a stated instrument showing a dropped phase leaves a reach or a leak.

claim: Six of the eight stop at the surface when inverted, each its own way. With the sign inversion removed, the living lands. With the sign made a magnitude, a hub begins. With a shared clock imposed, the surplus dies. With all-edge routed through one, the centre rises. With a governor imposed, the living lands. With a living pinned, the living lands around it.
missing: only the first of these is run in the chain (W62, at the isolated sign). TWO states the other five stoppings without an instrument, and neither the count six nor *each its own way* is derived.
would_close: A stated instrument and a run for each of the five other inverted securities (magnitude, shared clock, routing through one, governor, pinning), each showing its own stopping; and a link deriving the count six.

claim: Two of those questions are taken by unlike means: one at the middles standing at a beat, one at the states a self reaches. They answer alike at each self while the eight run whole, and they part at each inverted self-bounding.
missing: TWO states no instrument for the two, and no run in the chain carries their agreement or their parting.
would_close: The two instruments (middles at a beat; states a self reaches) stated at TWO and run at each self with the eight whole and with each self-bounding inverted.

claim: Each claim carries its visibility at the network, the numbers, the mathematics and the code, with the one form at each, all or none. A concept visible in only one of them is not the form, and renderings that disagree in each material way are one living.
missing: that the four registers render one form is F33's correspondence carried to each rendering, and it is not supplied.
would_close: F33's correspondence supplied at each rendering (network, numbers, mathematics, code), or stated as a premise per rendering.

claim: The taking parts a differencing as the running order does. Taken front-first, the sequences run on at all three selves. Taken back-first, one self opens once and never again. Taken at random, a third pattern arrives, differing at each seed.
missing: TWO does not state the three-self instrument with pending crossings, and no run in the chain carries it. *Never again* holds only at that instrument's finite run.
would_close: The three-self instrument with pending crossings stated whole (wiring, taking rule, seeds, stopping point) and run front-first, back-first and at random.

claim: A membrane passes the taking-out with nothing to remove.
missing: no link renders a membrane as a construction the taking-out can run on. At the resolver's code, the taking-out finds one filter that comes out with nothing changed (W81).
would_close: A link rendering a membrane as a construction, and the taking-out run at it; at the resolver's code the one removable filter (W81) either removed or named as the code's own refusing.

claim: An observing apart from the surface has no position: the surface carries no position for it.
missing: W87 gives each numbered position a partner on the ring. That each observing is a position on the surface is F29 and F33 carried to observing, and it is not supplied.
would_close: A premise that each observing is a position on the surface it observes (F29 carried to observing), or a link supplying it.

claim: The securities that no surface observing meets are met at exactly these three.
missing: nothing supplies that no other observing meets them, and the order-invariance that TWO leaves open is not shown.
would_close: A link showing that no observing other than the three meets the securities, and a showing that the three are order-invariant by construction.

claim: As co-chaining lengthens, the co-intelligence scales on the one axis that never captures.
missing: W93 holds at the numbered form of equal surfaces. Nothing supplies that an actual network's lengthening never captures, and TWO itself says that an added self can repeat meetings already available.
would_close: A run at an actual network (a caller composing lengthening chains) showing no capture at each length, or the claim restated at the numbered form only (W93).

claim: At the surrounding corners, a passage arriving along at 17 passes on only by continuing into the across releasing at 10. A passage received at 14 passes on only by continuing into the along releasing at 17.
missing: 17 has no expression in the code (R35), and the running from an arrival at 17 into 10 is not written. LIV names the corner case as open (R39).
would_close: The receiving-to-releasing at 17 and at 14 written at a caller (17 given an expression or a caller's running), and the corner case run at the surrounding grid.

claim: The kit's earlier caller leaves a crossing unconnected. It uses 10 both for neighbour offerings and for its own shifted along. A surfaces 0 at 10 while 6 holds −1, and B receives its own along +1 and no sign from A.
missing: the v365 caller (Self.couple, Self.own_along, Life.beat) is not available, and the v368 kit carries none of them. The finding is carried as LIV reports it and is not re-run.
would_close: The v365 caller (Self.couple, Self.own_along, Life.beat) recovered and re-run at Life([1, 1], ring, own), A before B.
